To manage her time effectively, Jane should leverage the quiet periods in her day, such as early mornings before the children wake up or during their naps, to write in short, focused bursts. She can also use audio recording apps to dictate story ideas when she cannot physically write, allowing her to capture inspiration while caring for her children or working. Additionally, setting a realistic goal of writing for just 15–20 minutes a day can help maintain consistency without overwhelming her busy schedule.
